content: Jesusta wanuchiy munapäcungan
Nä chaycunata ruracurcurmi, Jesusga nogacuna discïpuluncunawan jegara Jerusalén marcata, Israel castacunapa fiestäcuna captin.
Chay marcachrümi cara ‘Uyshacuna rantina puncu’ nipäcunganman nachrganachru juc gochrannuysi jatun pucyu pichga ramädayog. Chay jatun pucyutam hebreo rimaychrüga Betesda nipäcug.
Chaypa puncuncunachrümi chranin gueshyagcuna capäcug, ñaushacuna, ratacuna, gueshyagtucushacuna.
[Chay gochranyamanga juc angelmi jana pachapita aywachrämug. Jinarcurmi yacuta cuyuchig. Nätan chayman naupata jegarpugmi nä yacu cuyuyta usharuptinga cuticag ima-ayga gueshyapitas.]
Chaychrümi canag juc runa nä quima chrunca puwagniyog wata gueshyagtucusha.
Pay chrachrarayagta Jesús ricapururga, pasaymi tantiarun alisca unay nä gueshyayanganta. Chauraga tapurun gueshyagtam: “¿Cuticasha cayta munayanquichu?”
Niptinmi gueshyagga nin: “Tayta, manam pisi canchu yacu cuyurimungan üra cay gochranyaman jitayamag. Nätan imaysi, aywayta nacayaptilämi naupäta juc jegarpuyan”.
Niptin Jesusga nirun: “Sharcuy. Cämayta apacurcur aywacuy”.
Niptin runaga chayüram cuticarun. Jinarcurmi cämanta apacurcur aywacun. Chay junag cara jamana junagmi.
Jinarcurmi Israel castapa mandagnincunaga nirärinag chay cuticasha runata “¡Imanarayanquim! Cananga jamana junagmi. ¡Manam cämayta apanay junagchu!”
Nipäcuptin payga “Cuticächimagmi nogataga ‘Cämayta apacurcur aywacuy’ nimasha”.
Niptinga tapupäcunag: “¿Pimi ‘Cämayta apacurcur aywacuy’ nirushunqui?”
Nipäcuptin nätan runaga mana musyashachu pi cuticächingantas. Chay achca runapita Jesús nä aywasha captin.
Chaypitam Jesusga chay cuticächingan runata tarirun Diospa wayinchru, jinarcurmi cay nin: “Canan nä cuticarayarga, ama masta juchäcuychu, mana imas mas juyunnin pasashunaypag”.
Niptin runaga aywarunag chay Israel castacunapa mandagnïcunamanmi “Jesusmi casha chay cutichimagga” nir willapäcug.
Jesús “Diospa-mayinmi cayä” ningan
Chaypinpitam Israel casta mandagcunaga Jesusta ñawilanchru cachipäcura. Jinaman wanuchiylata munapäcura, jamana junagchru chay imacunatas ruraptin.
Chaura Jesusga rimapayta galacuyun cay nirmi: “Dios-mayïga chaynuylam ruranancunata rurayan canancamas, nätan nogas paynuymi rurayä”.
Chay niruptin chay mandagcunaga masran munapäcuras wanuchiyta, manam jamana junagchru uryangalanpitachu, antis “Tayta Diospa-mayinmi cä” ninganpitawanmi.
Chaura Jesusga cay nirunmi: “Mayapäcamay shumag: Noga Diospa-mayinga manam pasay imatas rurächu quiquiläpitaga, antis Dios-mayï rurayangantam nogas rurayäga.
Tayta Diosga cuyamarmi noga Dios-mayinta lapan rurayanganta musyachiman, nätan mas aliscacunataran musyachimangas mayacasha nirag capäcunaypag.
Tayta Diosga wanushacunata cawacächimunmi. Chaynuymi noga, Diospa-mayinsi munangätaga cawacächimü.
Tayta Diosga manam pitasi juchanta taripangachu, antis noga Diospa-mayintam chruramasha juchacunata taripänäpag.
Chaynuypa lapan runa, noga Diospa-mayintas Tayta Diostanuy alipa ricapäcamänanpag. Pisi nogata mana alipa ricamagga, cachramagnï Tayta Diostam mana alipa ricanchu.

Mayapäcamay shumag: Pisi, noga ningäta mayacamagga, jinaman cachramagnïman yupachicugga, nä galayurun imaycamas paywan cawaytam. Chauraga manam ‘Juchanpita imaycamas cunchuchisha cachun’ nishagchu. Nätan chaynuy mana nishagchu wanushanuysi cayanganpita imaycamas cawagman nä muyuruptinmi.

Mayapäcamay shumag: Nämi chayman nachrgararcayanqui. Nätan cananmi chay junag nä chraramun wanushacunanuysi cayagcuna, noga Diospa-mayin rimangäta mayapäcunan junagchru, jinaman cäsucamagcuna Dioswan cawapäcunan junagchru.
Tayta Diosga quiquinmi munayninwan cawachin pitas maytas. Chaynuymi noga Diospa-mayintas nimasha paynuysi runa cawachig canäpag.
Nätan nimashatan runacunapa juchanta taripänäpagsi noga jana pachapita shamusha runataga.
¿Imanirtag mana cäsucarcämanquichu? Chrämungam lapan wanushacuna shimïta mayapäcunan junag.
Chaychrümi ali ruragcuna cawacapäcamunga Dioswan imaycamas cawapäcunanpag, nätan lutan ruragcunas cawacapäcamunga imaycamas cunchuchisha capäcunanpag.
Nogaga manam imatas pasay rurächu quiquiläpitaga. Nogaga juchacunata taripayä Tayta Dios nimaptinmi, nätan nishagsi razoncagtam. Nogaga manam rurä munangätachu, antis cachramagnï munangantam.
Noga quiquiläpita rimaptïga, manam välinchu imapagsi.
Nätan noga pi cangätas razoncagta musyachishugniquicuna cayanmi.
Gamcuna cachrapäcuraymi Bautizag Juanman tapug. Payga nipäcushuray razoncagtam.
Manam nogaga pisi reguechimänantaragchu munä. Rimarcuyäga Juanpitas, gamcuna salvacurcänaypagmi.
Juanga cara juc achqui rupayagnuymi. Gamcunaga payta mayacur nä cushicugpagmi carcayaray ishcay quima junaglaga.
Nätan, noga pi cangätas, Juanpitas mas shumag musyachicug cayanmi. Chaura Tayta Dios nimangannuy rurayangäcunam, pay cachramanganta musyarcayächishunqui.
Jinamanga cachramagnï Tayta Diossi nogapitaga musyachipäcushuraymi. Nätan gamcunaga manam imaysi paypataga shimintas mayapäcuraypishchu ni paytaga ricapapäcuraypishchu.
Nätan rimangansi manatan shongoycunaman yaycunchu, Tayta Dios cachramunganta mana chrasquicurcaptiquim.
Gamcunaga Dios isquirbichingancunata aliscam yachracurcayanqui, ‘Dioswan imaycamas cawananchipag’ nir, nätan chay isquirbishacunaga nogapitam musyarcayächishunqui.
Chaynuy niyaptinsi gamcunaga, manam ni munapäcunquichu nogaman aywamuytaga Dioswan imaycamas cawapäcunaypag.
Nogaga manam munächu runacunapita alawasha cayta.
Nätan musyayätan Diosta mana cuyapäcungaytas.
Nogaga aywamurä Tayta Dios cachramaptinmi, jinatam mana chrasquipäcamanquichu, nätan quiquilanpita pisi aywamugtam ichaga chrasquicarärinquimanga.
Gamcunaga jucniquis jucniquis alawasha caylatam munarcayanqui, nätan manam japalaylan Diospita alawasha caytaga munapäcunquichu. Chaynuy jinayarga manam imaysi nogaman yupachicarcämanquichu.
Ama nipäcuychu nogapag ‘Paymi juchachämäshun Tayta Diospa naupanchru’ nirga. Juchachapäcushunquiga Moisespa isquirbishancunaman, chay yupachicurcayangaymi.
Razonpa Moisés ninganta chrasquicurcarga, nogatas chrasquipäcamanquimanmi. Payga isquirbira nogapitam.
Nätan pay isquirbingancunatas ‘Manam cayga Diospitachu’ nircayarga, ¿imanaypatag ‘Diospitam payga razonpa rimayan’ nipäcamanqui?”
